h1: USA B1/B2 visitor visa from the UK
intro: The B1/B2 visa is the US visitor visa for business (B1) and tourism (B2). You need it if you can’t use an ESTA, for example because of past travel, an arrest or a previous refusal, or if your passport isn’t eligible. We prepare your B1/B2 visitor visa application and check every detail before it is submitted.

sections.heading: Who needs a B1/B2 visa?
sections.text: Anyone who isn't eligible for an ESTA needs a B1/B2 visa to visit the USA, including many UK residents on non-British passports, and British citizens with certain travel history, arrests or convictions, or a previous ESTA or visa refusal.

sections.heading: Showing your ties to the UK
sections.text: At the interview, the officer will want to see that your visit is temporary and that you'll return. Evidence of your job, home, family and finances in the UK helps.

sections.heading: The US visa interview
sections.text: Most US visas involve the online DS-160 form, paying the visa fee, and an interview at the US Embassy in London or the US Consulate in Belfast. Every answer on the DS-160 must be accurate and match your documents. We prepare your form and tell you what to take to the interview.

sections.heading: B1/B2 visa help from Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and help travellers and businesses across the UK. We check the rules for your passport, prepare your application and keep you updated until it's decided.

faqs.q: Is the B1/B2 visa for business or tourism?
faqs.a: Both. B1 covers business visits and B2 covers tourism and visiting family. Most people are issued a combined B1/B2 visa.
Most applicants do, at the US Embassy in London or the Consulate in Belfast.

faqs.q: How long does a B1/B2 visitor visa take?
faqs.a: Processing times vary with the authority and the time of year. Apply as early as you can, and don’t book non-refundable travel until your visa or authorisation is approved.

faqs.q: Can you help with my B1/B2 visitor visa application?
faqs.a: Yes. We check which visa fits your trip, prepare your B1/B2 visitor visa application and documents, and keep you updated. Contact us or call 0161 956 2003.
